title: adjustable height ironing board
text: adjustable height ironing board. I really needed a full size ironing board and this one had good ratings, so that weighed into my decision.  It is exactly what I wanted.  I will say that I did order another cover for it - a non-stick thicker pad.  The one that comes with it is very, very thin and NOT non-stick.  It's my opinion the non-stick pad helps the iron do a better job pressing - but it might just be my opinion.  The ironing board is easily adjustable to many different heights - which is SO handy.  Depending on what you are ironing or where you are standing or sitting... I love that it is stable at any position.  The leg feet have rubber like stoppers on the ends.  This helps keep the ironing board stable on carpet or flooring.  Even though it's very stable, it's NOT really heavy which is also really important to me as I need to fold and lift it into a closet for storage.  I will say that I was worried about going to a big box or other store to buy the ironing board and then not being able to get into my car trunk - so home delivery was AWESOME.  It comes fully assembled, however, you WILL need to install the pad.  I never hesitate to update my review should new info seem useful and I hope this review has been helpful to you!

product_metadata.title: Homz Gray Marble Contour Ironing Board
features: 1 ⅜” THICK STEEL CURVED FEET: Thick steel contoured feet provide 30% more stability over the basic T-Leg design and the non-skid feet protect your tile or wood flooring
53.75" x 13" PERFORATED STEEL TOP: Offers a solid ironing surface and evenly distributes heat and steam onto garments, eliminating wrinkles effortlessly
100% COTTON COVER: A smooth cotton cover with a polyurethane foam pad allows your iron to glide across your garments and leave them wrinkle free
ADJUSTS TO ANY HEIGHT: Conveniently adjusts to any height, up to 37” tall
FOLDS FLAT: Patented leg lock system enables the lightweight board to be folded securely and easily carried to storage
NEUTRAL COLOR PALLET: Includes a marble gray and white cover design with white frame to compliment any laundry room
MADE IN THE USA: Homz is proud to be the only U.S. manufacturer of steel ironing tables
description: The Homz contour ironing board is an essential tool to keep all your clothing ironed and wrinkle-free. The 53.75” x 13” perforated steel top allows your iron to distribute heat and steam effectively onto your garments to eliminate wrinkles faster while maintaining a flat and stable ironing surface. A smooth 100% cotton cover with polyurethane foam pad enables your iron to freely glide across your dress shirts, pants, or sweaters and leave them crisp. Sturdy, durable, and reliable 1 3/8” thick steel contoured feet provide extra traction and stability when the board is in use and conveniently adjusts to any height, up to 37.5” tall. The patented leg lock system secures the legs and once the lightweight ironing table comfortably folds, it can be effortlessly transported to a closet, laundry room, garage, or any storage location. Cleaning instructions for ironing board cover: Use a damp soft cotton cloth to wipe down the cover and allow to air dry; not machine washable and do not put in dryer. Proudly made in the USA, Homz is the only U.S. manufacturer of ironing boards. For over 65 years, our facility in Seymour, IN has produced high quality steel-top ironing boards built to last for all your garment care needs.

details.Care instructions: To clean dampen a clean, soft cotton cloth and wipe down the cover. Do not machine wash the cover.
